nodes.label: React Compound Components mandate
nodes.rationale: Explicit architectural mandate for UI code, listed under React Native software best practices.

nodes.label: PROGRESS.md work-tracking workflow
nodes.rationale: Keeps a trail of completed and remaining work (DONE/IN PROGRESS/BLOCKED with reasoning) so other agents can pick up work using vertical-slicing, micro-task breakdowns.

nodes.label: Test-per-function testing policy
nodes.rationale: Every function must have its own passing unit test file covering happy and unhappy paths, ignoring edge cases unless requested.

nodes.label: verify.sh verification gate
nodes.rationale: Run -> Fix -> Commit -> Green: verify.sh must be run before every commit and pass (lint, typecheck, test) so every commit stays green.

nodes.label: Run A — with harness
nodes.rationale: Repo-level AGENTS.md, PROGRESS.md, verify.sh, and docs/software-principles.md were present; used to measure the harness's effect on the same task.

nodes.label: Run B — without repo harness
nodes.rationale: Only user-level Cursor rules and skills applied, isolating the repo harness as the removed variable.

nodes.label: Insight 1: Harness cost is discovery time, not implementation time
nodes.rationale: Explore-before-first-code was ~9 min with harness vs ~4 min without, almost the entire wall-time gap; the harness is a front-loaded, one-time comprehension tax that amortizes over repeated tasks.
nodes.norm_label: insight 1: harness cost is discovery time, not implementation time

nodes.label: Insight 2: User-level skills/rules still impose structure without the harness
nodes.rationale: Run B still wrote loading/error states, tests, and a commit because Cursor user rules and skills persisted; the repo harness's distinctive contribution is narrower: compound components, PROGRESS.md, test-per-function granularity, and verify.sh.
nodes.norm_label: insight 2: user-level skills/rules still impose structure without the harness

nodes.label: Insight 3: Verification gates are institutional memory
nodes.rationale: Run A had one known gate (verify.sh --lint-only) and one fix; Run B lacked verify.sh and hit 5 failing Jest runs re-discovering jest-expo/msw/pnpm config issues — losing a verification gate forces rediscovery of known-working tool-chain config.
nodes.norm_label: insight 3: verification gates are institutional memory

nodes.label: Insight 4: Architectural choices need explicit harness instructions
nodes.rationale: Run B, guided only by the react-native-patterns skill, defaulted to hooks + plain components; compound components appeared only because AGENTS.md explicitly mandated them, confirming the model has weak defaults for design patterns.
nodes.norm_label: insight 4: architectural choices need explicit harness instructions

nodes.label: Insight 5: Tool-call count is a weak proxy for effort
nodes.rationale: Total tool calls were similar (106 vs 116) but distribution differed: Run A skewed to Write/StrReplace/TodoWrite, Run B to Shell for live environment debugging — a working verification gate shifts effort from debugging to implementation.
nodes.norm_label: insight 5: tool-call count is a weak proxy for effort

nodes.label: Insight 6: Scope creep was not tested by this task
nodes.rationale: Neither run drifted into Step 2 despite vertical-slice guidance being present only in the harness; the prompt itself was scoped tightly enough that this guardrail wasn't stressed.
nodes.norm_label: insight 6: scope creep was not tested by this task
